content:
We just published a list of the 10 Best 52-Week Low NASDAQ Stocks to Buy According to Billionaires and Fermi (NASDAQ:FRMI) ranked 6th on this list.

Scan the Nasdaq stocks hitting 52-week lows this week and a pattern jumps out: many of the biggest names build, power or rent space for artificial intelligence. Few of these businesses are shrinking. Several reported record revenue in recent weeks, and their shares kept sliding anyway.

Photo by osamu nakazawa on Unsplash

A New Political Risk Arrives in Washington

Then came the election. Reuters reported on November 4 that Wall Street closed sharply higher after Democrats won Congress, but data center shares fell on fears of tighter AI regulation. Democrats made gains in Texas and Georgia, where public opposition to the industry's rapid expansion has been growing.

We also wrote about how leverage turned an AI bet into a fire sale for one fund .

The pressure carried into the next day. UBS analysts estimated that around 30% of expected US data center capacity additions in 2028 could be at risk from potential construction pauses, Reuters reported on November 5. Large technology companies, by contrast, rose on the view that a slower buildout would curb their own spending, Reuters said.

Fermi hit a new 52-week low and had 19 billionaire holders and 57 hedge fund holders as of Q2 2026.

Fermi has a huge plan and a thin record of turning it into rent. The company wants to build a giant power and data center campus in the Texas Panhandle, and its first prospective tenant walked away late last year. A $6.5 billion, 15-year lease with TensorWave for 222 megawatts followed this summer. But the lease did not take effect by its closing deadline last week because conditions were still unmet, and the shares fell. A regulatory filing also said Fermi's cash would not cover the next 12 months without more financing.

Bulls point to AMD, which signed a credit support agreement for the lease, and to the company's statement that the parties are still working toward closing. Fermi calls the AMD backing a key step toward project financing. The lease also lets the tenant expand the partnership to more than 650 megawatts, so a closed deal could grow well beyond the first building. That makes the closing, and the financing that follows, the event the stock now trades on.

You might also be interested in reading our piece on how a landmark power deal puts Fermi's big bet to the test .

While we acknowledge the risk and potential of FRMI as an investment, we believe certain AI infrastructure stocks offer far stronger long-term potential at a much more attractive entry point. If you are looking for an AI stock more promising than FRMI that operates as a critical AI tollbooth and stands as the most important company in the world, check out our report about this must-own AI stock .

chineseContent:
我们刚刚发布了亿万富翁评选的纳斯达克 10 支最佳 52 周低点股票名单，费米 (NASDAQ:FRMI) 在该名单中排名第六。

浏览一下本周触及 52 周低点的纳斯达克股票，就会发现一个规律：许多知名企业都在为人工智能建造、供电或租赁空间。这些业务中很少有萎缩的。最近几周，有几家公司公布了创纪录的收入，但他们的股价却一直在下滑。

照片由 osamu nakazawa 在 Unsplash 上拍摄

新的政治风险抵达华盛顿

然后是选举。路透社11月4日报道称，在民主党赢得国会后，华尔街收盘大幅走高，但数据中心股价因担心人工智能监管收紧而下跌。民主党在德克萨斯州和佐治亚州取得了进展，这两个州公众对该行业快速扩张的反对情绪不断增加。

我们还写了一篇关于杠杆如何将人工智能赌注变成一只基金的甩卖的文章。

这种压力一直持续到第二天。据路透社 11 月 5 日报道，瑞银分析师估计，预计 2028 年美国数据中心新增容量中约有 30% 可能面临建设暂停的风险。路透社称，相比之下，大型科技公司股价上涨，因为他们认为建设速度放缓将抑制自身支出。

截至 2026 年第二季度，费米创下 52 周新低，拥有 19 名亿万富翁持有人和 57 名对冲基金持有人。

费米有一个庞大的计划，但将其转化为租金的记录却很少。该公司希望在德克萨斯州狭长地带建立一个巨大的电力和数据中心园区，其第一个潜在租户去年年底离开了。今年夏天，TensorWave 签订了价值 65 亿美元、为期 15 年的 222 兆瓦租赁合同。但由于条件仍未满足，该租约并未在上周截止日期前生效，股价下跌。一份监管文件还称，如果没有更多融资，费米的现金将无法满足未来 12 个月的需要。

看多者将矛头指向了AMD，该公司签署了一份租赁信用支持协议，并且该公司声明称双方仍在努力完成交易。费米称 AMD 的支持是项目融资的关键一步。该租约还允许租户将合作伙伴关系扩大到超过 650 兆瓦，因此完成的交易可能会远远超出第一栋建筑的规模。这使得交割以及随后的融资成为股票现在交易的事件。

您可能还有兴趣阅读我们关于具有里程碑意义的电力交易如何考验费米的大赌注的文章。

虽然我们承认 FRMI 作为一项投资的风险和潜力，但我们相信某些人工智能基础设施股票在更具吸引力的切入点上提供了更强大的长期潜力。如果您正在寻找比 FRMI 更有前景的人工智能股票，该股票是关键的人工智能收费站，并且是世界上最重要的公司，请查看我们关于这只必须持有的人工智能股票的报告。
